items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: He had two sons playing in that band. John, Marera and Simon.

ctx.x: He was the manager of the Superior band too, I think, way back.

That's right. That's right. That's right. But him and I had that band together. I remember that. That's years ago. I mean, that's years ago. Then his son, Simon made a band, a young Olympia. He had two sons playing in that band. John, Marera and Simon. Simon. Simon. Yeah.
What was your drum set like? How many traps and all did you have? A snare and bass drum, anything else? Simple?
